name: Saber
scope: Preserve approved male reference; add the female profile.
steps: Extract the approved rules without changing their timings or contact behavior.
Resolve female sa roles from the matrix and validate native pwsa attacks; inspect class/body variants.
Keep rejected source 104 out of normal walk; explicitly retain source 200 general male walk and source 111 saber run.
acceptance: All shared tests pass for M/F; owner comparison finds no male regression.
status: Male and female reference pairs owner-approved; broader class and release gates remain

name: Sword
scope: Retain PSZ broad swings and adapt PSO sword stance.
steps: Verify male sw donor roles; discover missing female ready/block/walk entries rather than guessing IDs.
Author sword contact/recovery per step while preserving multi-target cap and turn limits.
Validate two-handed grip, floor clearance and heavy-hit feedback on both bodies.
acceptance: No body drift; correct multi-target count; identical normal/strong continuation timing.
status: Male and female reference pairs owner-approved

name: Daggers
steps: Find female dagger stance/reaction donors or approve explicit native fallback.
Keep each authored hit timestamp and target budget; do not collapse swings to one hit.
Throttle impact sound/particles and stagger to avoid noise or permanent enemy stun.
acceptance: Every intended contact fires once; fast input still distinguishes all three combo outcomes.
status: Male and female reference pairs owner-approved

name: Claw
steps: Audit female donor gaps and each hand attachment.
Use claw reach/turn limits and per-impact schedule rather than saber constants.
Check short reach against small enemies and moving targets; review flinch frequency.
acceptance: No phantom long-range hit or duplicated impact; explicit M/F locomotion fallback.

name: Double saber
scope: Preserve wide sweeps and mixed hit counts.
steps: Resolve sparse PSO ds roles; inspect HUcaseal attack overrides without replacing native swings.
Map female pwdss attacks separately from pwds_run.
Preserve per-step target counts and two-handed weapon orientation during spins.
acceptance: Multi-target sweeps and repeated hits match profile; no foot/root drift.

name: Spear / partisan
scope: Combine PSO partisan posture with native PSZ spear attacks and broader target coverage.
steps: Map male pa donor roles; discover female equivalents or explicit fallback.
Retain native PSZ attacks after owner rejected PSO retargeted swings; evaluate three-target coverage on every step.
Inspect shaft grip, tip path, caution/run and collision alignment on both bodies.
acceptance: Upright 145 caution carry, coherent partisan sweeps, one contact per swing and three-target cap.

name: Slicer
scope: Keep thrown-blade behavior under the shared combo states.
steps: Discover M/F stance roles and keep native PSZ attack sequences.
Drive projectiles from authored release events; preserve return/bounce/target rules.
Attach hit feedback to actual projectile damage, not release or swing end.
acceptance: No double release or phantom impact; interruption does not emit a delayed blade.

name: Gunblade
scope: Select slash or shot independently for each combo step from target distance; no manual mode toggle.
steps: Decide per-role saber/rifle donor choices; inspect shotgun GLBs and mixed prefixes.
Separate contact and projectile events, timing and feedback by mode.
Test all eight slash/shot sequences with every normal/strong combination; commit each action through its windup and cancel releases on interruption.
acceptance: No stale-mode shot, wrong pose or doubled damage; M/F grip and shooting alignment approved.
status: Male and female owner-approved; automatic mixed combos and blade-default stance.

name: Shield
scope: Establish a real profile before claiming support.
steps: Audit native shield assets and current runtime behavior; it has no dedicated WEAPON_ANIM_DATA entry.
Decide attack sequence, stance, guard arcs and shield-specific rules explicitly.
Implement only with resolved clips; otherwise leave disabled with an explicit unsupported state.
acceptance: No silent saber-library fallback; approved source/profile or documented exclusion.
status: Skipped by owner: shields disabled as purchasable/equippable weapons; future armor role undecided.

name: Handgun
scope: Use PSO movement/guard, retain PSZ firing sequence.
steps: Map hg M/F readiness, caution, run and block; fill map gaps explicitly.
Keep native shot steps and per-step release timing; retain ranged hit semantics.
Test muzzle alignment, moving targets and target-cursor sound/caution interaction.
acceptance: Each accepted step releases the correct shot; no melee-only hit policy leaks into guns.

name: Mechgun
scope: Preserve bursts rather than substituting one PSO shot.
steps: Audit pmmg/pwmgs clips and existing PSO locomotion bakes.
Keep all burst timestamps and projectile budgets; bound per-burst sound/particle density.
Check interruption during a burst and pending shots during equipment changes.
acceptance: Exact burst count; canceled future releases stay canceled; no stagger lock.

name: Rifle
scope: Adapt rifle posture with native PSZ rifle sequence.
steps: Use rifle_m/w runtime sources and pmar/pwars prefixes; do not accidentally use shotgun pmri retargets.
Map ri M/F locomotion/block with explicit missing-role handling.
Align shoulder, muzzle and projectile release across bodies and strong/normal steps.
acceptance: Correct native sequence and source provenance; no gender-prefix fallback accidents.

name: Bazooka
scope: Replace or formalize the current shotgun/rifle fallback.
steps: Audit whether a native bazooka sequence exists; do not label injected pmri clips PSZ-native.
Evaluate launcher donor la; choose explicit M/F fallback where unmapped.
Define actual step count and explosive release/recovery; preserve splash and immunity rules.
acceptance: Source provenance and supported sequence approved; no fabricated three-step combo or duplicate explosion.
status: Both genders owner-approved for this pass; minor grip refinements and repeated launcher combo remain follow-ups.

name: Laser cannon
scope: Owner-directed reuse of the bazooka fixture for both genders, including splash delivery; retain laser weapon model and stats.
steps: Inspect female cannon file containing pmlc_atk1 instead of assumed pwlcs_atk1.
Evaluate rifle posture donor as a proposal; discover a better donor if grip/recoil is unsuitable.
Retain actual step count and beam tick/piercing rules; separate release feedback from hit feedback.
acceptance: No duplicated beam damage; correct M/F clip selected explicitly; final-step recovery matches actual N.
status: Applied shared bazooka profiles, grips, single-shot shell and splash. Both automated fixture checks pass; separate visual testing waived by owner.

name: Rod
scope: Preserve physical attacks and technique casting.
steps: Map ro M/F stance, reactions and utility clips; inspect FOmarl-specific casting separately.
Retain native melee contact schedule, rod reach and physical hit feedback.
Keep technique charge/release/cancellation independent of weapon combo recovery.
acceptance: Physical impacts and casting both work; no lost charge or stale queued cast after melee interruption.
status: Male rod fixture prepared with native physical attacks and PSO rod stances; owner playtest pending.

name: Wand
scope: Preserve wand physical attacks and support casting.
steps: Resolve female prefix/source mismatches and sparse wn role map explicitly.
Tune wand contact/recovery, grip and effects separately from rod.
Test physical chains interleaved with support techniques and palette page changes.
acceptance: Both genders use intended clips; no inherited rod/saber timing or stale charge.

name: Unarmed
scope: Handle empty equipment as its own profile.
steps: Audit pmbn/pwbn native attacks and fi M/F stance/reaction candidates.
Decide unarmed block and ready behavior explicitly; do not inherit saber enum defaults.
Use empty-equipment feedback and reach; test equip/unequip at every phase.
acceptance: No invisible saber, weapon sound or leftover weapon cooldown; class-specific overrides documented.
